title: A Score That Knows What It Cannot Prove

ciFast.note: Fast verification will rerun the release, formatting, lint, unit, evaluation, build, and bundle gates after push.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof remains an explicit downstream workflow and is not represented as local benchmark evidence.

deploy.note: Deployment remains downstream of successful repository checks and merge.

liveProvider.note: A fresh opt-in five-lesson Urban Heat Resilience Algi run preserved the exact brief but composed only 1/5 evidence kernels. It reported 54/100 readiness and paused refinement instead of presenting a green 99/A.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, classroom, human-preference, accessibility-certification, universal factual-validity, paid-model parity, or adapter-superiority claim is made.

manualBrowser.note: The readiness chip, detailed report, exact title and five-lesson sequence, refinement state, and verified ZIP action were inspected in the real browser. The final 56-entry archive retained the same 54/100 readiness signal in its manifest and quality report.

claims.summary: The primary automated signal is separated from deterministic package conformance and capped below independent-evidence claims.
Five named components explain the readiness result and publish an explicit claim boundary.
A frozen three-case benchmark constrains generous, source-thin, and source-rich score behavior without claiming independent validation.
Internal sourceRef coverage earns no grounding credit without trusted concept-linked sources, and source-thin multi-lesson packages are reported.
The workspace, package manifest, and ZIP quality report reuse the same finish-pass readiness result.
Algi composition records grounded decline reasons, can recover from later exact passages, and rejects duplicate evidence distractors.
The live Urban Heat Resilience run retained exact brief fidelity, reported weak evidence composition honestly, and exported a score-consistent archive.
Held-out ruler V25 binds grader v1.11.0 and inherits no prior adapter or model result.

carryForward.item: Add independent instructor or observed classroom evidence before allowing any score above the automated 69-point ceiling.
Expand the locked readiness benchmark with additional real exported packages while preserving the frozen V1 cases and score windows.
Improve Algi provider breadth and concept extraction so more exact lessons can earn grounded composition without weakening admission.
Run same-commit paired Scion, Algi, hybrid, and paid-provider comparisons using the separated readiness and conformance measures.
Keep the optional adapter inactive until it beats base-only Scion on a newly frozen matched ruler.
